verdict.rationale: First-party docs show quantized inference on Gaudi (FP8/INT4) served through vLLM, and a community report puts memory bandwidth at about 3.7TB/s from 8 HBM2e stacks, comparable to the H100. The pack contains no published HBM capacity figure and no evidence that a 70B-class model fits on one card or one node. Missing for 10: published per-card memory capacity, first-party bandwidth spec, documented 70B-class single-node inference example, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run a 70B-class quantized LLM on this GPU — published VRAM capacity and memory bandwidth that make local or single-node inference practical

citations.quote: Run quantized models using FP8 or INT4 datatypes
With 8 stacks, though, it reaches about 3.7TB/s, comparable to the H100's 3.4TB/s on 5 stacks of HBM3.
